spans.s: (truṭi (f.), Skt., so read with v.l. for Lefm. truti, a small particle: LV 〔149.4〕; as a unit of measure, here = 7 aṇu, one-seventh of a vātāyana-rajas, q.v., which in LV is one-seventh of a śaśarajas; Tib. rdul chuṅ ṅu = small speck. Not in corresp. Mvy list, 〔8190 ff.〕; possibly cf. Tib. chu rdul = ab-rajas 〔8193〕, water-speck, between loharajas and śaśarajas, not in LV; can a corruption have occurred based on Tib. chuṅ, small, and chu, water?)
